selection_reason: O-9 inward bounding combined with the all-admissible-span stop rule. Absent independent boundary evidence an episode may begin no earlier than the first authoritative filing observation tying the CIK to the security and may end no later than the last; unsupported edges remain gaps. B is the smallest envelope that gives the adjudication a fair chance to resolve every admissible terminal span without manufacturing coverage or creating an avoidable HOLD. The decisive 20-year window beginning in 2022 does not make A sufficient: a STOP must survive optimistic treatment across ALL admissible >=20-year spans, which is why the earlier single-window K=13 reasoning was corrected. Cost reinforces but does not decide: +19 documents / ~4.4%, inside the prospectively stated 350-480 planning band.
